name: zinput_init_force_feedback_effect_set
description: zInput_DI_InitForceFeedbackEffectSet creates the standard force-feedback effect set and starts the steer and pitch force effects when they are available.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled in the zInput DirectInput/force-feedback source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42f9f0 validates effect creation order and storage offsets: primary fire 0.25, alt fire 0.5, collision 0.5, damage 0.5, ambient sine 0.05, steer direction 0x6978, pitch direction 0x4650, followed by Start(iterations=1, flags=0) on non-null steer and pitch effects and returning the input effect-set pointer.
The native smoke verifies seven effect creation calls, all effect-set slots populated, two Start calls for steer and pitch, and the final pitch direction descriptor.
